attribution.note: no positions held; nothing to attribute

decision.thesis: All-cash. Nothing in tonight's evidence supports a name: all nine returned not_significant, so the decomposition declines to separate a company story from noise on any of them, and no cause is claimed on the 2026-09-07 feedback page. Independently, six of the nine carry mis-dated prices - the Bursa proxy MYX:0820EA printed a blank 2026-09-07 row and the decomposition fell back to 2026-09-04 - so a target book weighted on those closes would be weighted on the wrong session.
decision.note: first decision the start rule did not refuse; the start date is 2026-09-08. Logged and graded, not applied (observe phase).

lessons: a book weighted on closes whose session is in doubt inherits that doubt at full size; the cheapest response to a dating fault is to hold nothing until it is settled
a high round-trip cost is a hurdle the thesis must clear before the position starts, not a friction to net off at the end
